title: Return eligibility
body: Items in resalable condition can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start from Order history; the portal displays the exact eligibility and label options.

title: Tracking has stalled
body: If tracking has no new carrier scan for 72 hours, verify the address and open a carrier investigation. Offer available replacement or refund options after the investigation threshold.

title: Duplicate payment
body: Compare the merchant transaction IDs and distinguish an authorization hold from a settled charge. Escalate two settled charges to payments; never ask for a full card number.

title: Account recovery
body: Send a reset link from the sign-in page. If it does not arrive, check spam and verify the account email without disclosing whether an unrelated address exists.

title: Product warranty
body: Use the serial number and proof of purchase to check product-specific coverage. Explain exclusions without promising approval before inspection.

title: Suspicious account activity
body: Ask the customer to reset their password and end other sessions. Escalate unauthorized access immediately; never request a password, PIN, CVV, or one-time code.
